label: If y can be without x and x cannot be without y, then y is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to x
paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of the criterion of natural priority: if y can be without x and x cannot be without y, then y is simply prior to x. Navigation only (no claim): Aquinas, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 15, 'priora dicuntur, quae possunt esse sine aliis et illa non possunt esse sine eis', said of priority 'secundum naturam'; reading it for the simple priority of DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY is the analyst's.
